channel.title: Ghosxt Blog: Managed IT & Cybersecurity for the Central Coast
channel.description: Practical IT, cybersecurity, and compliance guidance for small businesses on California's Central Coast, from an engineer with DoD infrastructure experience.

item.title: Report Phishing Email: Set Up a Report Habit (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: How to report a suspicious email at work. Set up a report button, a simple rule, and a fast response so one report protects your whole small business.

item.title: Fake Boss Text Scam: Stop Gift Card Fraud (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Got a text from your boss asking for gift cards? It is a scam. See how the fake boss text works and 5 ways a small business can stop it.

item.title: Malicious Email Attachments: What to Block (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Which email attachments are dangerous? See the risky file types, why a PDF or ZIP can still hurt you, and 5 steps a small business can take now.

item.title: Infostealer Malware: Stop Stolen Logins (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Infostealer malware steals saved browser passwords and session cookies. Learn how it spreads and 5 steps a small business can take to stop it.

item.title: Vendor Bank Detail Change Scams: Stop Them (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: A fake 'we changed banks' email sends your vendor payments to a criminal. See how payment redirect fraud works and the 4 checks that stop it.

item.title: Fake Password Reset Calls: Stop Them (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Attackers call your help desk or staff posing as an employee to reset passwords and MFA. Learn the 4 verification steps that stop it at a small business.

item.title: Fake E-Signature Request Scams (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Fake DocuSign-style e-signature emails steal Microsoft 365 and Google logins. Learn how to spot them and the 4 checks that keep your small business safe.

item.title: Tax Season Scams for Small Business (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: W-2 phishing and payroll diversion scams spike every tax season. Learn how they work and the simple checks that keep employee data and paychecks safe.

item.title: Backup Internet for Small Business (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: When your internet goes down, so does your business. See how a cellular backup connection and automatic failover keep you working, and what it costs.

item.title: Remove Local Admin Rights on Laptops (2026)
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Local admin rights turn one bad click into a full compromise. See why to switch employees to standard accounts, how to roll it out, and what to expect.

item.title: Break-Glass Admin Account for Microsoft 365
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: A break-glass account keeps you from being locked out of Microsoft 365 when MFA fails. Learn how to create one, secure it, and test it every quarter.

item.title: How Often to Replace Business Computers
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Most business laptops and desktops last 4 to 5 years. Learn the signs it is time to replace, how to stagger a refresh, and what to budget per seat.

item.title: Dormant Account Cleanup for Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Unused accounts are open doors for attackers. Find dormant Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace logins, disable them safely, and set a quarterly review.

item.title: Small Business Password Policy: Stop Forced Changes
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Forced 90-day password changes weaken security. Use the modern NIST-based small business password policy: length, MFA, a password manager, and breach checks.

item.title: Video Conference Security for Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Secure Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet meetings. Lobby, passcodes, screen-share limits, recordings, and guest rules a small business can set in 3 steps.

item.title: Microsoft 365 Backup for Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Microsoft 365 is not a backup. Learn what Microsoft does and does not protect, and how to back up email, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams in 3 steps.

item.title: SaaS Subscription Audit for Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Unused software seats waste money and leave live logins behind. A 4-step SaaS audit to find, cut, and secure every subscription your business pays for.

item.title: PHP2Shell: Critical PHP Flaw Puts Websites at Risk
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) lets attackers take over PHP websites with no login. The fixed versions and what to check today.

item.title: UPS Battery Backup for Small Business Offices
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Power blips crash servers, corrupt files, and kill your internet. Learn what a UPS does, which gear needs one, and how to size and test it.

item.title: Secure Disposal of Old Computers and Hard Drives
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Throwing out old PCs and drives can leak customer data. Learn how to wipe, destroy, and document disposal of business computers the right way.

item.title: Business Firewall vs ISP Router for Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Is the router from your internet provider enough? Learn what a business firewall adds, what to look for, and how to set one up without slowing your team.

item.title: Shared Logins and Shared Mailboxes: Stop Sharing One Password
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Sharing one password across the team is risky. Learn how shared mailboxes, delegated access, and a password manager keep accounts secure and auditable.

item.title: October 2026 Patch Tuesday: Record 1,400 Fixes, 3 Zero-Days
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: October 2026 Patch Tuesday: a record 1,400-plus fixes, one exploited Windows Shell zero-day, and what a Salinas small business should do this week.

item.title: I Clicked a Phishing Link: What to Do Next
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Clicked a phishing link or opened a bad attachment? The first-hour steps to contain it: disconnect, change passwords, revoke sessions, and report.

item.title: Conditional Access in Microsoft 365
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Conditional Access decides who gets into Microsoft 365 and when. Five starter policies small businesses can turn on this week, plus common lockout mistakes.

item.title: Network Closet and Server Room Security
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Unlocked network closets invite tampering and theft. How small businesses secure server rooms: locks, access logs, cooling, cabling, and backups.

item.title: Secure File Sharing for Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Email attachments and open links leak data. How small businesses share files securely with clients using expiring links and named-person access.

item.title: Security Camera Security for Small Business
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Hacked IP cameras and NVRs are an easy way into your network. How small businesses secure cameras: passwords, updates, VLANs, remote access.

item.title: Email Encryption for Small Business: What to Encrypt and How
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Email is not private by default. When small businesses need email encryption, TLS vs message encryption, and setup in Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.

item.title: Single Sign-On (SSO) for Small Business: Is It Worth It?
item.dc:creator: Ulises Paiz
item.description: Single sign-on gives employees one secured login for every app. How SSO works, what it costs, and how to roll it out in Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.
